description: Search the job offers (temporary work, fixed-term and permanent contracts) published by Actual group in France. Combine a free-text query with a town and filters. Filter values for contractType, family, industry and region must be exact French values: get them from list_offer_facets. Use get_offer with a result's slug for the full offer.

agencyCode.description: Only offers handled by this agency: the agency code returned by find_best_agency.

contractType.description: Contract types (exact values from list_offer_facets), e.g. ["Contrat de travail temporaire", "CDI"].

lang.description: Language of the offer texts and URLs. Defaults to fr.

pageSize.description: Results per page, 1 to 20. Defaults to 10.

q.description: Free text: job title, skill or keyword, e.g. "cariste", "soudeur TIG", "aide-soignant".

radius.description: Search radius in km around the town. Defaults to 20.

region.description: French regions (exact values from list_offer_facets), e.g. ["Bretagne"].

town.description: French town or postal code to search around, e.g. "Rennes" or "35000".

name: search_offers
title: Search job offers
